visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three pairs of legs in black trousers and leather shoes march rhythmically across a white studio floor. (2) Quick-cut close-ups show a yellow polo shirt being adjusted, a person's nape being combed, and a woman's eyes behind clear-framed glasses squinting as she puts them on. (3) A split-screen compares a lush green mountain landscape under a bright sky with a crashing ocean wave, framing two silhouettes. (4) In a bright white studio, a man in a light blue blazer and a woman in a black blazer face each other, then turn to the camera with raised fists and open mouths, shouting enthusiastically. (5) A rapid montage features scenes at a race track, a construction site with white helmets, a band rehearsing with neon vests, and coastal cliffs. (6) Further scenes include cosplayers in vibrant purple and yellow outfits on a city street, a woman in a pink dress holding a microphone in a market, and a man at a computer with a pixelated crying face overlay. (7) Group shots depict the team in white uniforms and helmets cycling through a park with branded stickers on their baskets. (8) The camera captures diverse travel locations: a red suspension bridge in a forest, a rocky shoreline with fishermen, and international urban landmarks like the Rain Vortex in Singapore. (9) A series of individual profile cards show team members in branded vests against various backdrops, from Christmas trees to traditional temples, each performing a signature pose. (10) The video concludes with a full group lineup in front of a colorful, sparkling background with text celebrating a subscriber milestone.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with low-frequency atmospheric drone sounds and a deep, resonant male voice speaking with significant breathiness and slow delivery. High-tension strings build up in the background. (2) A sharp transition occurs with a percussive impact SFX, leading into a high-tempo (128 BPM) electronic pop track. Multiple voices are heard shouting with high arousal and positive valence. (3) A male narrator provides an energetic, professional-toned recount of events. This is layered with various post-production SFX: rhythmic mouse clicks, a high-pitched comedic bleep during a mosaic effect, and festive firework explosions. (4) The audio texture shifts to include outdoor field recordings of wind and distant crowd chatter, while the BGM maintains a consistent, driving beat. (5) A group of voices chants in unison, characterized by high volume and synchronized timing. (6) A sequence of individual vocal segments features different speakers shouting slogans with varied pitch and comedic inflections. SFX like sparkle chimes and impact thuds emphasize these transitions. (7) The video ends with a triumphant musical swell, followed by the sound of sustained applause and cheering from a large crowd.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Retrospective -> Accomplishments -> Team Showcase -> Emotional Climax -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A high-energy celebratory video commemorating the 10-year journey of the HahaTai channel and achieving the 1 million subscriber milestone. It uses a dynamic montage to showcase the diversity of their content, cultural impact, and team members while expressing gratitude to the audience.
